transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this recovery huddle started. As we all know, robotic palletizer P-4 went down during the morning shift, and we have an urgent outbound order due at the end of the week. We have the manual palletizing station in the finished-goods warehouse available as a temporary alternative, but I need to hear from each of you before I make a decision on the recovery method. Let's go through the three areas we need to cover: maintenance findings on P-4, shipment staging requirements for the urgent order, and energy-isolation controls for whatever work we proceed with. Who wants to start?
